sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select rule,code,owner,due_on,finding from accreditation_attention order by rule,code

sections.title: Committee agenda
sections.sql: select code,organisation,due_on,evidence_gaps,open_findings,case when required_count>0 and evidence_gaps=0 and open_findings=0 and completed_visits>0 and clear_reviewers>0 and unresolved_conflicts=0 then 'ready for human decision' else 'blocked' end as readiness from cycle_readiness where status='active' order by due_on,code

sections.title: Standards coverage
sections.sql: select code,cycle,standard,version,owner,required,evidence_count,valid_evidence,open_findings from evidence_matrix order by cycle,code

sections.title: Review team
sections.sql: select a.code,c.code as cycle,a.person,a.role,a.conflict_state,a.declared_on from assignments a join cycles c on c.id=a.cycle_id order by c.code,a.code

sections.title: Renewals due
sections.sql: select code,organisation,owner,renewal_on,last_decision from cycle_readiness where status<>'withdrawn' and renewal_on<=current_date+60 order by renewal_on,code

sections.title: Corrective actions
sections.sql: select f.code,r.code as requirement,f.owner,f.severity,f.due_on,f.status,f.verified_by from findings f join requirements r on r.id=f.requirement_id order by f.due_on,f.code
